description:
Activate Wild Cantor by sacrificing it, adding {R/G}.
Korvold's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Wild Cantor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Korvold trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and causing you to draw Wild Cantor from the top of your library.
Cast Wild Cantor by paying {R/G}.
Repeat.
